blind.description: A freestanding castle-style masonry wall segment with an arched doorway opening. Constructed from rough-cut stone blocks with voussoirs forming the arch, large rectangular blocks above, and flat capping stones lining the top. The masonry features weathered dark grey and warm brownish-tan stone textures with green moss staining near the bottom base. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and cleanly modeled. The structure stands directly on its own two base piers flat against the floor.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular strip showing four dark grey capping stones in a straight line, casting an arched doorway shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.25 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 7 to 7.5 ft tall), and about 4 to 5 ft wide.
